name: io.github.Dirard/mcp-file-tools
title: MCP File Tools
description: Token-efficient read-only project navigation over stdio with compact text results

tools.name: set_cwd
tools.description: Register an absolute local directory and return cwd_id.

tools.name: project
tools.description: List a bounded project tree under cwd_id with resumable pagination.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Find files, text lines, or symbols under cwd_id with resumable pagination.

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read source ranges or parser outlines for up to 24 files under cwd_id.
